# Workspace Instructions

## Project
- React, Vite, and TypeScript. Keep page sections in `src/App.tsx`, reusable UI in `src/components/`, and responsive styles in `src/styles.css`.
- Use semantic HTML and preserve keyboard access, reduced-motion support, and responsive layouts.
- Do not invent image URLs. Use authorized local artwork or visibly labeled placeholders.
- Keep comparisons of cross-universe battles clearly framed as hypothetical, not official canon.

## Commands
- `npm run dev` starts the Vite development server.
- `npm run build` runs the TypeScript check and production build.
